Run one chunk of a chunked SLURM array simulation

Source: R/cluster.R
medsim_run_chunk.Rd

Runs replications [(chunk_id-1)*chunk_size+1 .. chunk_id*chunk_size] and saves a single RDS file named chunk_<chunk_id>.rds in output_dir. Designed to be called from inside a SLURM array task script; chunk_id and n_chunks are auto-detected from config (which auto-reads SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID).

The chunk .rds is the sole artifact: in chunk mode the intermediate per-scenario/summary CSVs that a standalone medsim_run() writes are skipped (concurrent array tasks sharing an output_dir would clobber the fixed-name files, leaving partial data that looks complete). Result rows record the global replication id (schema v2): chunk 2 of a 4-chunk/nsim-20 run writes replication 6..10, not 1..5, so ids never collide across chunks and medsim_combine_chunks() can audit the combined grid.

Each chunk file also carries a provenance attribute (Gate C): R version, medsim + key dependency versions, hostname, a code SHA, and seconds-per-replication timing. The SHA is auto-detected from the run script's git tree (falling back to a pkg:medsim-<version> tag outside git); pass code_sha to stamp explicitly. medsim_combine_chunks() asserts a single SHA across all chunks – catching a mid-run code edit plus partial resubmit, which would silently mix results from two different code states.

Usage

medsim_run_chunk(
  scenarios,
  method,
  config,
  verbose = TRUE,
  code_sha = NULL,
  compute_truth = NULL,
  truth_on_failure = c("stop", "warn")
)

Arguments

scenarios

A list of medsim_scenario() objects.

method

A function with signature method(data, params).

config

A medsim_config object with chunk_id and n_chunks set.

verbose

Logical: print progress messages.

code_sha

Character or NULL: code-state identifier stamped into the chunk's provenance. NULL (default) auto-detects via git rev-parse HEAD in the running script's directory, degrading to pkg:medsim-<version> outside a git tree.

compute_truth

Optional function with signature (data, params), passed to medsim_run(). Without it the combined result carries no $truth, so it supports power analysis but not coverage or bias. Only chunk 1 computes truth; every other chunk ignores compute_truth, so truth is computed once, not once per chunk. Set config$compute_truth_every_chunk <- TRUE to compute it in every chunk (useful only when truth is cheap and chunk 1 may not survive). Truth is seeded from config$seed, so chunks that compute it agree, and medsim_combine_chunks() keeps one row per scenario from whichever chunks carry it. The chunk's provenance records truth_requested, so a combine that should have truth but does not raises a truth_coverage violation.

Chunk 1 then runs longer than the others (truth plus its replications); size --time for it, not from a pilot of another chunk. To keep chunk 1 balanced, compute truth once before submitting: a short medsim_run() over the same scenarios, compute_truth and output_dir warms the truth cache, and chunk 1 then loads the truth instead of computing it. Keep passing compute_truth to the chunks: it is what records truth_requested, so a lost truth is still reported at combine.

truth_on_failure

"stop" (default) or "warn", passed to medsim_run(). Under "stop" a failed truth stops chunk 1 before any replication runs, so no chunk file is written and the array task exits nonzero.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the RDS file written. If a task-level error (a medsim_run_failure from medsim_run()) interrupts the chunk, whatever replications completed are still written – atomically, with provenance partial = TRUE – before this function re-stop()s so the array task still exits nonzero (sacct visibility, not a --requeue signal). This holds even when NO replication completed: a chunk whose every replication failed writes a flagged, zero-row file rather than no file at all. That file is the only carrier of the partial = TRUE marker, and without it a trailing all-failed chunk would combine with zero violations (the contiguity audit cannot see it – the surviving ids are a clean 1..k block). medsim_combine_chunks()/medsim_audit_results() flag any such chunk via the partial_chunk violation.

medsim_combine_chunks(), medsim_audit_results(), medsim_write_submit_script()
